name: NOCDURNA pivotal program
question: Does low-dose desmopressin orally disintegrating tablet reduce nocturnal voids and increase 33% responders versus placebo in men and women with nocturia?

design.population: Separate trials randomized 395 men and 268 women with at least two nocturnal voids nightly.
design.description: Two multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized trials
design.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01262456 and NCT01223937, Study Design and Participant Flow; PubMed abstracts, Methods

verdictNote: Both coprimary endpoints favored each tested dose in men and the 25-μg dose in women.
takeaway: In separate three-month trials, desmopressin ODT 50 or 75 μg in men and 25 μg in women reduced nocturnal voids and increased 33% responders versus placebo; the men's primary report found the 50-μg dose effective with fewer marked sodium decreases than 75 μg.

reports.label: Men's phase 3 trial (CS41)
reports.citation: Weiss JP, Herschorn S, Albei CD, et al. "Efficacy and Safety of Low Dose Desmopressin Orally Disintegrating Tablet in Men with Nocturia: Results of a Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo Controlled, Parallel Group Study." *J Urol.* 2013;190(3):965-972. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2012.12.112
reports.followUp: Three-month double-blind treatment; full analysis set 385 men

results.measure: Placebo-adjusted mean difference in change in nocturnal voids during three months
results.note: 50 μg versus placebo; full analysis set 385 men across all arms.

results.measure: Odds of at least 33% fewer nocturnal voids during three months
Placebo-adjusted mean difference in change in nocturnal voids during three months
Odds of at least 33% fewer nocturnal voids during three months

results.endpoint: Time to first nocturnal void, men
results.measure: Approximate placebo-adjusted mean difference in time to first void at three months
results.note: Approximately 40 minutes longer for both doses; P=0.006 for 50 μg and P=0.003 for 75 μg.

harms.label: Serum sodium below 130 mmol/L
harms.note: The two men at 50 μg were aged 74 and 79 years; the abstract does not give arm-level safety denominators.

delivery.label: Men's trial dosing
delivery.value: Desmopressin ODT 50 μg or 75 μg versus placebo for three months.

reports.followUp: Three-month double-blind treatment; full analysis set 261 women

results.note: 25 μg versus placebo; full analysis set 261 women.
